seo.title: Triathlon coaching – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Individual triathlon coaching with personal training plans and support. Book a free intro call.

title: Triathlon coaching
lead: Individual training that fits your life – and makes you measurably faster.

offers.title: Training plan
offers.audience: For self-driven athletes with a clear goal
offers.text: An individual plan for your season goal – matched to your level and the time you have.

offers.title: Personal coaching
offers.text: Ongoing support with weekly adjustments to your training, your schedule and your data.

offers.title: Race prep
offers.text: Targeted preparation for one race – including pacing, nutrition and mental preparation.

process.title: Intro call
process.text: A free first conversation about your goals, experience and everyday life.

process.title: Analysis
process.text: I review your training data and define the starting point.

process.title: Plan & training
process.text: You receive your individual plan and we get started.

process.title: Feedback & adjustment
process.text: Regular check-ins make sure training keeps fitting you.

faq.question: Who is the coaching for?
faq.answer: Anyone who wants to train with structure – from a first sprint triathlon to the full distance.
